newsitem.title: USA: Suburban files for 4.24 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Suburban files for 4.24 mln shr offering.

text.p: Suburban Lodges of America Inc said Wednesday that it filed for a 4,243,000 share offering of common stock with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The issue which consists of 4.0 million shares offered by the company and 243,000 shares offered by certain selling stockholders, will be managed by Montgomery Securities, Smith Barney Inc, J.C. Bradford & Co. and Legacy Securities Corp.
Suburban granted the underwriters a 30-day option to buy up to an additional 636,450 shares to cover over-allotments.
Suburban Lodges of America franchises Suburban Lodge economy extended stay hotels.
